name: summary-t02-collapsed-2x
eval: (() => { const card = document.querySelector('[data-pinned-summary]'); const panel = document.getElementById(card.querySelector('[aria-controls]').getAttribute('aria-controls')); return { text: card.firstElementChild.innerText, height: Math.round(card.getBoundingClientRect().height), panelHeight: panel.getBoundingClientRect().height, inert: panel.inert, bg: getComputedStyle(card).backgroundColor, glass: [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-glass]')].map(e => e.dataset.glass) }; })()

name: summary-t04-why-2x
eval: (() => { const card = document.querySelector('[data-pinned-summary]'); const panel = document.getElementById(card.querySelector('[aria-controls]').getAttribute('aria-controls')); return { expanded: card.querySelector('[aria-expanded]').getAttribute('aria-expanded'), inert: panel.inert, flags: [...card.querySelectorAll('[data-flag]')].map(f => f.dataset.flag + ': ' + f.textContent), reasons: [...card.querySelectorAll('[data-caution]')].map(r => (r.dataset.caution === 'true' ? 'caution ' : 'check ') + r.querySelector('p').textContent), rules: [...card.querySelectorAll('[aria-label="Hard rules hit"] li')].map(l => l.textContent), confidence: card.querySelector('dd').textContent, fitsViewport: card.getBoundingClientRect().bottom < innerHeight }; })()

name: summary-t05-stale-why-2x
eval: (() => { const card = document.querySelector('[data-pinned-summary]'); return { flags: [...card.querySelectorAll('[data-flag]')].map(f => f.textContent), citation: card.querySelector('[data-source]').textContent, struck: getComputedStyle(card.querySelector('[data-source] .line-through')).textDecorationLine, route: [...card.querySelectorAll('dd')].at(-1).textContent }; })()

name: summary-t17-paused-why
eval: (() => { const card = document.querySelector('[data-pinned-summary]'); return { headline: card.querySelector('p').textContent, confidence: card.querySelector('[data-confidence]').textContent, route: [...card.querySelectorAll('dd')].at(-1).textContent, rules: [...card.querySelectorAll('dd')][1].textContent }; })()

name: expand-transition
eval: (() => { const card = document.querySelector('[data-pinned-summary]'); const panel = document.getElementById(card.querySelector('[aria-controls]').getAttribute('aria-controls')); const s = getComputedStyle(panel); const chevron = getComputedStyle(card.querySelector('[aria-expanded] svg')); return { property: s.transitionProperty, duration: s.transitionDuration, easing: s.transitionTimingFunction, midwayHeight: Math.round(panel.getBoundingClientRect().height), fullHeight: panel.firstElementChild.firstElementChild.scrollHeight, chevron: chevron.transitionProperty + ' ' + chevron.transitionDuration }; })()

name: expand-reduced-motion
eval: (() => { const card = document.querySelector('[data-pinned-summary]'); const panel = document.getElementById(card.querySelector('[aria-controls]').getAttribute('aria-controls')); return { transition: getComputedStyle(panel).transitionProperty + ' ' + getComputedStyle(panel).transitionDuration, heightAfter30ms: Math.round(panel.getBoundingClientRect().height), fullHeight: panel.firstElementChild.firstElementChild.scrollHeight, chevronDuration: getComputedStyle(card.querySelector('[aria-expanded] svg')).transitionDuration }; })()

name: keyboard-expand-and-inert
eval: (() => { const card = document.querySelector('[data-pinned-summary]'); const button = card.querySelector('[aria-expanded]'); const panel = document.getElementById(button.getAttribute('aria-controls')); return { focusOnToggle: document.activeElement === button, focusVisible: button.matches(':focus-visible'), expanded: button.getAttribute('aria-expanded'), inert: panel.inert, j_still_moves_list: null }; })()

name: expand-keeps-latest-message-in-view
actions: window.__before = (() => { const s = document.querySelector('main ol').parentElement; return { gap: s.scrollHeight - s.clientHeight - s.scrollTop, draftBottom: Math.round(document.querySelector('[data-draft]').getBoundingClientRect().bottom) }; })()
eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('main ol').parentElement; return { before: window.__before, after: { gap: Math.round(s.scrollHeight - s.clientHeight - s.scrollTop), draftBottom: Math.round(document.querySelector('[data-draft]').getBoundingClientRect().bottom), viewport: innerHeight } }; })()

name: summary-t21-narrow-900-why
eval: (() => { const card = document.querySelector('[data-pinned-summary]').getBoundingClientRect(); const main = document.querySelector('main').getBoundingClientRect(); const ol = document.querySelector('main ol'); const bubble = ol.querySelector('li > div').getBoundingClientRect(); const olBox = ol.getBoundingClientRect(); return { mainWidth: main.width, cardInside: card.left >= main.left && card.right <= main.right, cardLeftInset: Math.round(card.left - main.left), columnLeftInset: Math.round(olBox.left + parseFloat(getComputedStyle(ol).paddingLeft) - main.left), horizontalOverflow: ol.parentElement.scrollWidth > ol.parentElement.clientWidth }; })()

name: wide-alignment
eval: (() => { const card = document.querySelector('[data-pinned-summary]').getBoundingClientRect(); const ol = document.querySelector('main ol'); const o = ol.getBoundingClientRect(); const pad = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(ol).paddingLeft); return { card: [Math.round(card.left), Math.round(card.right)], column: [Math.round(o.left + pad), Math.round(o.right - pad)] }; })()
